command: Anopheles gambiae PGRPLB (F5HMW5) has peptidoglycan immune receptor activity, contributes to defense against Gram-positive bacteria, or localizes extracellularly. Evaluate each separately from amidase activity. Identify whether direct peptidoglycan binding and catalytic depletion mediate sensing/signaling, immune suppression or another role. Compare actual tested peptidoglycan chemotypes and bacterial species rather than equating DAP-versus-Lys specificity with an absolute Gram classification. Assess N-terminal topology and experimentally demonstrated secreted or membrane pools, including isoforms.
